testimonials.title: What I Stand For
testimonials.description: Teamwork, respect, community support, and helping others. I believe in working together, caring for people, and making a positive difference.

items.name: Team
items.message: Isse has already impressed us in his first year of training as an IT Specialist for Application Development with his reliability, commitment, and ability to learn quickly. He takes on projects independently, develops creative solutions, and always works responsibly. We especially appreciate his initiative, friendly personality, and enthusiasm for IT. We are happy to have him as part of our team!

items.name: Mrs Schneider
items.message: He is a very kind and helpful young man. The world has become so digital these days that, honestly, I sometimes don’t understand everything. Whenever I have trouble with my phone or computer, he always takes the time to help me and explains things in a way that I can easily understand. I’m very grateful to him.

items.name: Ahmed Yuusuf
items.message: I collaborated with Isse on a non-profit project to build a School Management System for a school in Somalia that couldn’t afford one. Isse handled the frontend development and made a valuable contribution to the project. Our collaboration was smooth and productive, and I hope we can work together again on future non-profit projects.

items.name: BIRGIT RADECK
items.role: S.T.A.R. – Integration Project for Migrant Women
items.message: Isse is actively involved in volunteering with the migrant self-help organization “Immigrant Networks”, where he contributes with great dedication and commitment. He is responsible for the organization’s website and also actively supports events and community celebrations. Isse is reliable, works quickly and efficiently, and is always willing to lend a helping hand whenever needed. With his friendly, open-minded, and committed attitude, he is an important source of support for the organization. He is a valuable asset to all of us and to the wider community of the city.
